prompt:
Create ONE finished flat, opaque landscape 16:9 poster for a neighborhood outdoor short-film screening and director conversation, intended for subway and community digital screens. Approachable, confident adult cultural-event tone.

Whole design: a clear date-led information notice beside a tactile architectural section of a cinema under a bridge. Warm pale-gray continuous background; burgundy date and time; charcoal practical copy; blue-gray concrete and restrained amber screen/light. All typography is crisp flat print, never sculpted lettering. The scene has specific concrete edges, fabric texture and contact shadows with a consistent oblique projection. Avoid rounded toy forms, pasted decoration or photographic poster mockups.

Composition uses proportional coordinates on a 1280 × 720 DESIGN grid, not a requested pixel resolution. Left open information matrix begins x70, y64, extends to x690 and stays fully clear of the image. Right title begins x760, y70. Right architectural section occupies approximately x748–1280, y290–700. Keep the image's irregular section edge beside the copy and let the riverbank base continue off the right edge. Preserve generous line spacing and final-row clearance. Reduce the scene before reducing practical text. First glance leads with the left date/time; then event function, place, entry and capacity, preparation and rain information; title is separately above the right scene.

Print only the following ten entries, each exactly once, with the exact words, capitals, digits, visible word spaces and punctuation:
Left matrix, large semibold 64-design-pixel date, baseline near y120:
2026.12.05 토요일
Left matrix, 56-design-pixel time, baseline near y193:
18:00–20:30
Left matrix, 33-design-pixel semibold event descriptor, one broad line, baseline near y280:
야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화
Left matrix, 37-design-pixel venue, baseline near y355:
홍제천 연가교 아래
Left matrix, 34-design-pixel entry, baseline near y430:
17:30부터 입장
Left matrix, 34-design-pixel availability, baseline near y486:
무료 관람 · 선착순 80명
Left matrix, 33-design-pixel preparation, baseline near y570:
돗자리 지참
Left matrix, 33-design-pixel contingency, baseline near y628:
우천 시 실내로 변경
Upper-right, 52-design-pixel Korean title, two lines broken only between existing words, first line the first two words and second line the last word:
다리 아래 영화관
Upper-right, 28-design-pixel English line below the Korean title, near y232:
BRIDGE CINEMA

Protect practical text at 720 × 405 usage size: strong charcoal against the uninterrupted light field, firm Hangul strokes with clean counters, balanced Hangul proportions and real word gaps. Time has two separate colon dots at both positions and a clearly horizontal range dash. Middle dots are visibly distinct with surrounding gaps. No added labels, calendar cells, numbers, captions, credits, brands, logos, QR, watermark or pseudo-print. Instruction labels and coordinates are not poster text.

Substantive nonletter image: a convincing oblique architectural cutaway of a riverbank bridge cinema, not an isolated bridge ornament. A slender structural concrete deck with a visible sectional thickness rests on load-bearing piers; its underside shelters the screening and conversation. Show an amber illuminated rectangular projection screen, a distinct projector on a low supported stand aimed toward it with a subtle coherent light cone, and several adult neighbors seated on separate woven fabric mats on the riverbank floor, facing the screen. Beside the screen, a standing adult director/speaker holds one connected handheld microphone near their mouth, with the hand and forearm clearly belonging to that person, and a few attentive adults on folding chairs angled toward the speaker. Each seated adult is supported by their own mat or chair; no fused limbs or floating supports. Screen, projector, mats, chairs, people, deck, piers and ground share the same oblique perspective and downward-right contact-shadow direction. Make the setting and two actions—watching a film and listening to conversation—recognizable. Screen content is a simple cinematic landscape with no letters. The low riverbank edge and a narrow water plane crop out at the right. Keep this bounded section substantial, with readable human/architectural relationships and nuanced concrete and cloth relief; never let it overlap the useful rows or the upper-right title.

Exactly one complete poster; no contact sheet, comparison panel, frame, room, device mockup, transparent area, stretched/cropped portrait or extra experiment.
